tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i mngon par rtogs pa rnam dag snang ba bzhugs//

"$ ༄༅// bla ma dang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes sku// nyi ma'i lus dang pad ma'i spyan// sangs rgyas seng ge'i gdan bzhugs pa// dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal// gang du de yi sgrub pa'i thabs// rgyud 'grel las ni gang gsungs pa// phyi nang gzhan gsum rtogs bya'i phyir/ bsgoms pa'i rim pa gsal bshad bya/ de la re zhing bsgrub pa po dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig la gnas pas las so so dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su rnal 'byor la brtson par 'dod pas/ bskyed rims dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis las/ dang po la gsum ste/ bsrung ba dang*/ bskyed pa dngos dang*/ las so so'i nges pa'o// bsrung ba ni sngon du lus dang gdong sbyang bar bya ste/ zhi ba dang rgyas pa la dpral bar bam̐ las zla ba/ dbang dang dgug pa la mgrin par ram̐ las nyi ma/ bsad pa dang bskrad pa la snying gar yaṃ las sgra gcan/ rengs pa dang rmongs pa la lte bar bam̐ las mjug ring*/ gso ba la spyi bor ham̐ las nam mkha'i rang bzhin du bsgoms te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣa/ pra dz+nyo pā ya āt+ma ko/ kā ya wā ka tsit+ti dz+nyā na a ti pa ti/ ma ma kā ya wāka tsit+ta dz+nyā na badz+ri/ badz+ra a mri ta sarba bam̐ ku ru ku ru kan dha dhā tu a yata na ni sa bhā ba swa hā zhes brjod de lus sbyangs la/ oṃ swa bhā ba shudhā sarba dharmaḥswa bhā ba shudho ham̐ gis dag par byas nas gtsug tu ham̐/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar ho/ gsang bar k+ṣa rnams gnas drug tu rgyal ba drug gi ngo bor bltas la/ oṃ hraḥsarba ma ra sarba a ḍa rā dza ka kle sha shan t+yam̐ ka ra badz+ra tiṣ+ṇa du kha ts+tshe da/ ma ma bi sho dha ya swā hā zhes lag pa sbyangs nas/ g.yon pa'i the chung nas tshigs rnams la ā li thung ba bco lnga/ g.yas su lā la sogs pa ring ba bkod la/ kha sbyar te dbus su nyi zla hūm̐ dang bcas pa bsams la rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcings nas/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣa/ ka ya wā ka tsit+ti dz+nyā na a ti pa ti badz+ra kā ya/ ma ma kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dz+nyā na badz+ra kā ya sa bhā ba ku ru swā hā/ zhes byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra kā ya swa bhā ba ād ma ko ham̐/ zhes nga rgyal byas rigs drug dgod de/ snying gar oṃ hri da yā ya nam/ spyi bor oṃ hūm̐ shi ra si swā hā/ gtsug tu oṃ hri shi kha ra yi be'u sha ṭa/ dpral bar oṃ hri ka ba tsa ya hūm̐/ mig tu oṃ hriṃ ne tra yā be'u sha ṭa/ lus thams cad la oṃ hra a sta phaṭa/ dge mi dge la g.yon dang g.yas kyi se gol byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya shi ra shi kha ka ba tsa nai tra a sta badz+ra sha ṭa gha swa bha ba āt+ma ko3 ham̐/ zhes nga rgyal bya'o// de nas lus rdo rjer bsgoms te/ 'khor lo drug tu ham̐ la sogs pa las byung ba rtsa 'dab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i rtse mo can/ ka tsa ṭa pa ta sa'i yi ge ring thung las/ rkang lag gi tshigs la rdo rje rtse mo sum cu pa/ sor tshigs la bdun pa/ dbang po rtse gsum pa/ las dbang rtsa lnga par bdag nyid bsgom mo/ zhing skyong rnams la gtor ma byin nas/ phyogs kyi kha dog dang mthun pa'i mes phyogs bcur son pa'i bgegs rnams bsregs la/ oṃ a hūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣa hraḥhraḥhraḥhraḥr ra ra ra badz+ra a na la sarba a pa ra na dharma pra la yā/ swa bhā ba sarba ma ra ka yi ka si big nan bi na ya dha ki naṃ das dam ta naṃ kā ya bāg tsi tra ni/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa bha smiṃ ku ru ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes so// de nas mdun du/ yam̐ ram̐ bam̐ lam̐ las rlung me chu dang sa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bsgoms te gcig tu gyur pa las/ dbus 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ rdo rje ra ba gsum dang bcas pa'i brtseg pa lnga 'og tu mdung dang steng du mda'i dra ba bar rdo rje'i sa gzhir bsgoms la/ oṃ ham̐ yam̐ ram̐ bam̐ lam̐ badz+ra a ka sha bā yu ste dzā/ u ta ka pṛ thi bī/

badz+ra swa bhā ba pañtsa dha du be badz+ra maṇa dha la ni ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ra badz+ra tsan tra sur+ya rā hū kā la ag ne kā ya wā ka tsit+tā dz+nyā na badz+ra pra ka ra ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ bi sha ka yā badz+ra ku tra gha ra ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes sbyin gyis brlabs nas/ dbus su/ oṃ bi sha badz+ra pad ma ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ra badz+ra sur+ya ā pa ni ku ru swā hā/ zhes pad ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'i khro bo chen po rdo rje'i shugs dus kyi 'khor lo lta bu phyag rgya gnyis lhag pas glang po'i lpags pa 'dzin cing sbrul rgyan dang thod phreng stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can du bskyed la/ lha rnams spro ba ni/ nam mkha'i rigs 'og gi lha rnams rna ba g.yas nas so// ye shes kyi rigs te steng gi lha rnams g.yon no// sna bug g.yon dang g.yas na rlung shar dang mer ro// mig g.yon dang g.yas nas me lho dang lho nub/ lce dang dri chu'i sgo nas chu byang dang byang shar/ dri chen dang spyi gtsug nas sa nub dang nub byang du spro bar bya ste/ snying gar nyi ma la ha ya ra ba la'i sa bon brtsegs pa las/ ha las steng du gtsug tor ljang gu hā las 'og tu gnod mdzes sngon po/ i las shar du bgegs mthar byed dang*/ ī las mer dbyug sngon gnyis nag po/ ṛ la lho ru shes rab mthar byed dang*/ ṝ las lho nub tu 'dod pa'i rgyal po gnyis dmar po/ u las byang du pad ma mthar byed dang*/ ū las byang shar du mi g.yo ba gnyis dkar po/ l̥ las nub tu gshin rje mthar byed/ l̥̄ las nub byang du stobs po che gnyis ser po/ thams cad kyang nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ oṃ hūm̐ kro ta ham̐ kro ta nam̐ adz+nya dha ka yā swa hā/ oṃ ham̐ badz+ra kro ta rā dza ma hā ūṣ+ṇi ṣa u ta di shi rak+ṣam̐ ku ru ku ru sā hā/ oṃ yam̐ badz+ra kro ta rā dza a ti pa la sarba big nan ta ka pur ba de shi/ oṃ ya badz+ra kro ta nī la dāṇ+ṭha ka aka ni ye shi/

oṃ ram̐ badz+ra kro ta rā dza dzam̐ pa ka duṣ+ṭaṇa pradz+nyā na ta ka dha k+ṣa ni de shi/ oṃ lā badz+ra kro ta rā dza ma ha bā la bā ya be de shi/ oṃ ha badz+ra kro ti rā dza suṃ bha a dho ti di shi rak+ṣa ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes bka' bsgo bar bya'o// 'khor lo'i phyi rol rim pa gnyis pa bsrung ba'i don du/ nga nya ṇa ma na las 'phros pa/ nga dha las steng 'og tu stong pa'i zad par ro// nyi nyī las rlung shar dang mer ro// ṇi ṇi las me lho dang bden bral/ mu mū las chu byang dang dbang ldan/ na nā las sa nub dang rlung du ste/ thams cad rang rang gi 'byung ba'i gdan la'o// rim pa gsum par/ bsrung pa'i phyir gha dzha ḍha bha dha las 'phros pa/ gha ghā las tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug ni steng 'og tu ngang pa dang bya khyung zhon pa/ dzhi dzhī las bden bral dang rlung ni shar dang mer/ yi dwags dang ri dwags la gnas pa/ dhi dhī las gshin rje dang me lha ni lho dang lho nub tu ma he dang ra la gnas pa/ bhu bhū las rgya mtsho dang drag po ni byang dang byang shar du chu srin dang khyu mchog la gnas pa/ dhi dhī las dbang po dang gnod sbyin ni nub dang nub byang du glang po dang gter la gnas pa'o// ra ba bzhi par ga dza ḍa ba da las byung ba gza' rnams spro ste/ ga gā las sgra gcan dang dus me steng 'og tu'o// dzi dzī las zla ba dang nyi ma shar dang mer ro// ḍi ḍī las gza' lhag dang mig dmar te lho dang lho nub tu'o// bu bū las pa ba sangs dang phur bu ni byang dang dbang ldan du'o// di dī las mjug rings dang spen pa nub dang rlung du ste rang rang gi dkyil 'khor la'o// rim pa la par kha tsha tha pha tha las klu rnams spro ste/ kha khā las rgyal ba dang rnam par rgyal ba steng 'og tu'o// tshi tshī las stobs kyi rgyu dang pad ma ni shar dang me'i 'tshams su'o// ṭhi ṭhī las nor rgyas dang dung skyong ni lho dang lho nub tu'o// phu phū las mtha' yas dang rigs ldan ni byang dang byang shar du'o// thi thī las pad ma chen po dang 'jog po nub dang nub byang du'o// ra ba lnga'i phyi rim pa drug lnga pa la ka tsa ṭa pa ta ṭha las 'byung po spro ste/

ka kā las ro la sa dang grul bum ste steng 'og tu'o// tsi tsī las rta gdong can dang kha gdong ste shar dang mer ro// ṭi ṭī las phag dang bya rgod kyi gdong can lho dang lho nub tu'o// pu pū las stag dang 'ug pa'i gdong can byang dang byang shar du'o// ti tī las lce spyang dang bya khyung gi gdong can nub dang rlung gi mtshams su ste thams cad kyang 'byung po'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa phyogs kyi mdog can rim pas dgod par bya ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rak+ṣa tsakra swa bhā āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bya'o// bsrung ba'i 'khor lo 'di ni bgegs dang byad la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad bsrung ba ste/ dbang gi don du ji skad bstan pa'i gtor ma btang ste phyi rol phur bus btab ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa badz+ra ki la ya wā ka tsi t+ta dz+nyā na a ti pa te ṣa ṭa mu khā ṣa ṭa bu dza ṣa ṭa tsa ra naṃ sarba big naṃ ya ka di dus s+tha naṃ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dz+nya badz+ra na ni ki la ya oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ces btab nas/ oṃ l+li badz+ra mu ka ra mā ra di nam ra si kan de hri da yi bh+yo ghu h+yen dhe badz+ra ka la yā ka na/ a ko ṭa ya a ko ṭa yā/ ྐྷྃ ྐྷྃ'a ྐྷྃ ྐྷྃ'a k+ngī k+ṣī k+tsa k+tsā k+ṣ+li k+ṣ+li hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ces brdungs te/ ji skad gsungs pa bya'o// bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'o/// /bcom ldan 'das bsgrub par 'dod pa yis/ bdud rtsi'i ri lus kha dag par byas la phyag rgya bzang pos lus la gtugs nas sngar bshad pa'i sngags kyis kyang kha lag sbyangs te/ snying gar pam̐ las pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa de'i steng du oṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa de las 'od 'phros te/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drangs la phyag byas te sngags kyi 'od zer las mchod pa spro ste/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe gan dha ar tsa nam̐ ku ru ku ru swā hā/

oṃ badz+ra māl+ye mā la ar tsa nam̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe dhū pa ar/ oṃ dhi pi dhi pa ar/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ te nai we d+ye pu dza/ oṃ badz+ra ag k+ṣa tre ak+ṣa ta phal ar tsa naṃ/ oṃ badz+ra las+ya s+t+rām̐ a bha ra naṃ pū tsa/ oṃ badz+ra hā s+ye ghaṇ+ḍe ḍa ā dar+ṣa pū tsa/ oṃ badz+ra bād+ye bā t+ya pu tsa/ oṃ badz+ra nri t+ye nri t+ya pu tsa/ oṃ badz+ra ghi te ghi ta pū tsa/ oṃ badz+ra ka me sarba bud dha bo dhe sa twa ni badz+ra pu ra ta pu tsa ku ru ku ru swa hā/ zhes lha mo bcu gnyis gnyis kyi rnam pa dpag tu med pas mchod do/ sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bya ste/ rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal lo// ma lus mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ slan chad nam yang mi bgyid do// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras// sna tshogs dge ba gang mdzad pa// rnyog bral byang chub rjes mthun pa// kun la dga' bas yi rang ngo*// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs nas kyang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'phrog byed pa// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// 'gro ba kun gyi don gyi phyir/ byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// bsam pa yongs su dag pa yis// byang chub sems ni rab bskyed de// bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa dor// pha rol phyin pa bcu spyad cing*// tshad med bzhi la gnas pa dang*// bsdu ba rnam gzhis yongs su bsdu// nyon mongs sgrib pa bcu spangs nas// lta sogs zag pa bzhi dor te// stong nyid mtshan med smon pa bral// mngon par 'du mi byed bsgoms pas// 'gro ba kun la phan bya'i phyir// bla med sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces brjod nas ji ltar 'jig rten sdud pa ltar/ kun gzhi'i rang bzhin hūm̐ las gzhan pa thams cad bsdu ste// dngos po med pa bsgom pa min// dngos po'ang bsgom par bya ba min/ de bzhin dngos po dngos med min/ bsgom pa dmigs su med pa'o// oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nya na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/

oṃ a ṇi mi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ a na bhi sa ska ra dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 ham̐/ dang po'i sbyor ba'o// de nas sngon gyi smon lam las chos 'byung gi dbus su// yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi pa las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po g.yung drung gis mtshan pa 'bum phrag gsum mo// baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po 'bum phrag gnyis pa zlum po pad mas mtshan pa'o// lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po 'bum phrag gcig ste thams cad kyang rdo rjes steng 'og mtshan pa'o// mam̐ las rdo rje ri rab ni/ 'og la stong phrag bcu drug steng lnga bcu pa/ k+ṣa las pad ma stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa'i sum char khyab pa'i nyi zla sgra gcan ha tsheg drag thig las byung ba'o// de'i dbus su rdo rje gur gyi nang du/ bh+rum̐ mam̐ oṃ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang pa rim pa gsum gru bzhi pa sgo bcu gnyis rta babs dang bcas pa glang chen seng ge lha'i na chung dang rgyan thams cad kyis mdzes pa/ thugs kyi 'khor lo dkar dmar sngo ba'i brtsig pa gsum pa/ gsung dang sku ni ye shes la sogs pa'i kha dog lnga'o// pha gu dmar po dra phyed nag po/ mda' yab dang pu shu rin po che'i phreng ba can/ zla phyed rdo rje dang*/ rnga yab dril bu la sogs pa'i brgyan thams cad kyis mdzes pa/ sku'i rta babs la 'khor lo bum pa rnga bo che dang shing gis mtshan pa/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo gru bzhi la rdo rje'i gdung ka ba bcu drug bum pa'i kha dog lta bus bteg pa shar dang me nag po/ lho dang bden bral dmar po/ nub dang rlung ser po/ byang dang dbang ldan dkar po/ dbus sngon po la pad ma ljang khu/ phyi rol sa chu me rlung nam mkha' rdo rje 'od kyi khor yug gis bskor ba/

dbang ldan du sa la zla ba gang ba bden bral du nyi ma dang bcas pa/ me rlung bar du dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa ni gzhal yas khang ngo*// de'i dbus su pad+ma la zla nyi sgra gcan gyi steng du/ g.yas su bdud dmar po zhal cig phyag bzhi pa g.yas mda' lnga dang zhags pa g.yon gzhu dang lcags kyu can dga' mo dang bcas pa dang*/ g.yon du drag po dbang phyug dkar sngo zhal cig phyag bzhi pa g.yas rtse gsum cang te'u g.yon thod pa kha ṭ+wām̐ can u ma dang bcas pa'i steng du/ oṃ dang bcas pa'i ā li bcu drug ring thung las zla ba me long lta bu'i ye shes rnam snang gi rang bzhin/ kā li ṭa ta pa tsa la dang bcas pa ring thung las nyi ma mnyam pa nyid rin chen 'byung ldan te/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyi rgyu'o// dbus su hūm̐ yig so sor rtog pa 'od dpag med srog rlung gi ngo bo hi don yod grub pa bya ba nan tan te/ 'od zer 'phro 'du las thams cad 'dres shing ham̐ sngon por 'gyur te/ de yang rdo rje ham̐ gis mtshan par yongs su gyur pa las sku rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog mthing ka zhal bzhi pa mgrin pa gsum pa la/ mgrin pa nag po'i steng na rtsa zhal sngon po khro 'dzum pa/ g.yas kyi mgrin pa dang zhal dmar po sgeg cing chags pa/ g.yon gyi mgrin pa dang zhal dkar po zhi ba'o// rgyab zhal ser po bsam gtan gyi tshul can thams cad kyang spyan gsum gsum pa/ ral pa'i cod pan sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ sngo dmar dkar ba'i dpung pa gsum gsum ste drug pa/ gru mo bcu gnyis pa/ phyag ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste/ sngo dmar dkar ba'i phyag bzhi bzhi'o// phyag mdzub rnams ni the bo na sa chu me rlung ye shes kyi kha dog can tshigs rnams sngo dmar dkar ba/ g.yas rnams kyis/ rdo rje ral gri dang rtse gsum gri gug dang*/ me'i mda' dang*/ lcags kyu/ rnge chung dang*/ tho ba dang*/

'khor lo mdung*/ dbyug pa dgra sta'o// g.yon rnams kyis dril bu/ phub/ kha ṭ+wam̐ ka/ thod khrag gzhu/ zhags pa/ rin po che/ pad ma dkar po dang*/ dung dang me long dang*/ lcags sgrog tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas dmar po brkyang bas bdud dang*/ g.yon bskum pa dkar pos dbang phyug yab yum mnan pa/ rdo rje'i dbu'i nor bu dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ lag gdub dang*/ ske rags dang*/ zhabs gdub dang*/ dar dpyangs dang*/ rdo rje'i phreng bas brgyan pa stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs 'phyang ba/ thal ba dang mchod phyir thogs dang mgo bo'i phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ de'i pang du sna tshogs yum zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ sku dang rtsa ba gser gyi mdog can/ g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ rgyab zhal nag po/ phyag g.yas rnams kyis gri gug dang lcags kyu dang kha ṭ+wam̐ ga dang phreng ba/ g.yon gyis nya phyis dang zhags pa dang*/ pad ma'i dkar po dang rin po che/ spyan bcu gnyis pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ bde ba chen pos snyoms par 'jug pa'o// 'dir yab yum gnyis ka rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can no// pad ma'i 'dab ma brgyad la du ba ma la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad de/ thams cad zhal bzhi phyag brgyad spyan bcu gnyis ma/ de yang a ha las shar dang mer ni nag mo 'bar ma te g.yas dmar g.yon dkar rgyab ser ba/ phyag g.yas spos dang tsan dan dang gur gum dang gla rtsi'i snod 'dzin pa/ g.yon na dril bu dang pad ma dang me tog dmar po dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba'o// aḥhaḥlas lho dang bden bral du dmar mo 'bar ma/ g.yas ser g.yon nag rgyab kyi zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas kyis mar me dang do shal dang*/ dbu rgyan dang gdub bu 'dzin pa'o// g.yon na gos dang ske rags dang*/ rna cha dang rkang rgyan 'dzin par mdzad pa'o// ā hā lā nub dang rlung du ser mo 'bar ma ni/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar rgyab kyi zhal nag po/ phyag g.yas kyis dung dang gling bu dang nor bu dang ḍa ru bsnams pa'o// g.yon pas pi wang dang rnga zlum dang 'khar khrol dang zangs dung 'dzin pa'o// oṃ ham̐ las byang dang dbang ldan du dkar mo 'bar ma g.yas nag g.yon ser rgyab kyi zhal dmar ba/

phyag g.yas kyis 'o ma dang chu dang lha'i sman dang chang gi snod rnams 'dzin pa'o// g.yon na bdud rtsi dang grub pa'i dngul chu dang bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu dang*/ 'bras khrol gyi snod 'dzin pa ni phyogs kyi'o// 'tshams kyi lha mo bzhi ni rnga yab brgyad brgyad 'dzin pa'o// kun kyang zla ba'i gdan la mnyam pas gnas pa phyag rgya lnga dang ldan par bsgom mo// mer hūm̐ las nor bu/ bden bral du a las gan dhe/ rlung du ho las dpag bsam gyi shing*/ dbang ldan du oṃ las dung ste phyogs kyi kha dog rdo rje bzhi'i rang bzhin no// rgyu'i he ru ka la'o// de nas gtsug gtor du ham̐ spyi bor oṃ mgrin par ā snying gar hūm̐ lte bar ho/ gsang bar swa yig rnams bkod la nor bu hūm̐ las rdo rje phaṭa kyis mtshan pa'o// yum gyi chos 'byung a las pad ma as mtshan par byin gyis brlabs la/ gnyis su med par snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen pos gnas lnga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros te phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas mchod cing bsdus yab kyi zhal du zhugs nas yum gyi khar phab ste lha thams cad bskyed pa ni/ sa bon las phyag mtshan de las lhar gyur par bsgom ste/ nang gi re mig gi 'tshams su hi hī hri hrī h+li h+lī hu hū las bum pa brgyad de rgyal dang rnam rgyal shar nub tu dgod do/ 'dir lha thams cad zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal re re'ang spyan gsum pa/ 'du byed dang tshor ba dang gzugs dang 'du shes dang ye shes rnam shes kyi khams las byung ba ste/ re'u mig la shar du i las don yod grub pa spyan mas 'khyud pa/ mer ī las sgrol ma rnam snang gis 'khyud pa/ khyams kyi snam bu la shar sgo'i g.yas su e las nam mkha'i snying po la dri rdo rjes 'khyud pa/ me ru ai las reg bya rdo rje ma sgrib pa thams cad sel bas 'khyud pa/ shar sgo ya las khro bo shin tu stobs reng byed mas 'khyud pa/

thams cad kyang sku dang rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas kyis ral gri dang gri gug dang rtse gsum pa'o// g.yon gyis phub dang thod pa dang kha ṭ+wām̐ ga bsnams pa ste/ sgrol ma'i g.yon tha ma ut+pa la'o// lho ru re mig la ri las rin chen 'byung ldan mā ma kīs 'khyud pa/ bden bral du rī las gos dkar mo 'od dpag med kyis 'khyud pa/ snam bu la lho'i g.yas su ar las sa'i snying po gzugs rdo rjes 'khyud pa/ bden bral du ār ro'i rdo rje ma spyan ras gzigs kyis 'khyud pa/ lho sgor ra las khro bo rmongs byed nga rgyal byed mas 'khyud pa ste/ thams cad kyang sku dang rtsa zhal dmar ba g.yas dkar g.yon nag po/ phyag g.yas rnams me'i mda' dang lcags kyu dang cang te'u rim par bsnams pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis gzhu dang zhags pa dang nor bu cha dgu pa rnams 'dzin pa'o// nub tu li las rnam par snang mdzad sgrol mas 'khyud pa/ rlung du lī las spyan ma don grub kyis 'khyud pa/ snam bu la nub sgo'am g.yas su al las sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba reg rdo rjes 'khyud pa/ rlung du āl las dri yi rdo rje ma nam mkha' snying pos 'khyud pa/ nub sgor la las khro bo rangs byed shin tu stobs mas 'khyud pa ste/ thams cad sku dang rtsa zhal ser ba g.yas dkar ba ga yon nag po/ phyag g.yas rnams 'khor lo dang dbyug pa mi 'jigs pa rdo rje'o// g.yon pa rnams dung dang lcags sgrog dang dril bu'o// byang gi phyogs su re mig la u las 'od dpag med gos dkar mos 'khyud pa/ dbang ldan 'tshams su ū las ma ma ki rin chen 'byung ldan gyis 'khyud pa/ snam bu la byang sgo'i g.yas su o las 'jig rten dbang phyug rdo rjes 'khyud pa/ dbang ldan du ā+o las gzugs kyi rdo rje ma sa'i snying por 'khyud pa/ byang sgor ba las khro bo nga rgyal byed ni rmongs byed mas 'khyud pa/

thams cad sku dang rtsa zhal dkar ba g.yas nag g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas rnams tho ba dang mdung dang rtse gsum pa/ g.yon pa pad dkar dang me long dang*/ phreng ba bsnams pa'o// steng phyogs su o las mi bskyod pa ljang gu sna tshogs mas 'khyud pa/ a las phyag na rdo rje ljang gu sgra rdo rjes 'khyud pa/ rdul tshon la lho sgo'i g.yon du'o// au las chos dbyings rdo rje ma ljang gu kun du bzang pos 'khyud pa/ rdul tshon la nub sgo'i g.yon du'o// 'og tu a las rdo rje sems dpa' sngon po rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas 'khyud pa/ aṃ las kun du bzang po chos dbyings rdo rjes 'khyud pa rdul tshon la shar sgo'i g.yon du'o// aḥlas sgra'i rdo rje ma sngon mo phyag na rdo rjes 'khyud pa/ rdul tshon la byang sgo'i g.yon du'o// thams cad kyang g.yas na rdo rje dang gri gug dgra sta'o// g.yon na dril bu thod pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo ste kun du bzang po'i tha ma ni ud pa la 'dzin pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sku mdog dang mtshungs pa g.yas dmar g.yon dkar ba'o// lha thams cad kyang rgyal ba bzhi dang sems dpa' rnams rdo rje'i dkyil dkrung*/ yum rnams pad ma'i bzhugs stangs te/ khro bo yab yum rnams bcom ldan 'das yab yum bzhin du phyogs rnams nyi ma mtshams zla ba'am shar dang byang dang steng zla ba lho dang nub dang 'og nyi ma la gnas pa rdo rje'i rgyan rnams kyis brgyan pa'o// phyi rol mchod pa'i snam bu dkar po la tsa sde las shar du dri dang phreng ba ma/ lho ru ṭa sde las spos dang mar me ma/ nub tu ta sde las sgeg mo dang bzhad ma'o// byang du pa sde las bdud rtsi ma dang zad med ma phyogs kyi kha dog can no// rta babs kyi sar shar nub tu ka sde las gar ma dang sil snyan ma/ lho byang pa sde las glu ma dang 'dod ma ste sngon mo dang ljang gu'o// thugs kyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa'o// de nas gsung gi 'khor lo 'khyams kyi lha'i snam bu la gnas pa'i pad ma phyogs dmar zhing 'tshams dkar ba 'dab ma brgyad pa la gnas pa dbus su gtso mo brgyad dang 'khor rnal 'byor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi ste/

shar du yi dwags dmar po'i steng du ha las tsar tsi mun ti nag mo zhal bzhi phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas na gri gug dang rtse gsum g.yon pa na thod pa dang kha ṭ+wām̐ ga bsnams pa dbang po ser pos 'khyud pa'o// 'dab ma la mdun dang rgyab tu hi hī gzhan drug la g.yas bskor du ya yi yi/ yu l+yi yaṃ las/ 'jigs ma/ drag mo/ dus kyi mche ba ma/ 'bar ba'i gdong can/ rlung gi shugs can/ rab gtum ma/ gtum mig ma/ sna chen ma rnams so// me ru mkha' lding gi steng du k+ṣa las khyab 'jug ma nag mo// zhal cig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas pas 'khor lo dang dbyug to// g.yon na pad ma dang dung 'dzin pas/ tshangs pa ser pos 'khyud pa'o// 'dab ma la sngar ltar k+ṣi k+ṣi yi yī yi yū yī yaṃ las/ dpal ma/ sgyu ma/ smin drug ma/ dpal mo/ rnam par rgyal ma/ dpal rgyal ma/ rgyal bar byed ma dang*/ dpal gyi 'khor ma rnams so/ lho ru ma he'i steng du ni hāḥlas byung pa'i phag mo dmar mo// zhal cig phyag bzhi ma g.yas na dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon na lug gu rgyud dang phub 'dzin pa/ drag po dkar pos 'khyud pa'o// 'dab mar hri hrī ri rī rī ru rli raṃ las/ keng rus ma/ dus mtshan ma/ khros ma'i zhal/ dus kyi lce ma/ mche gtsigs ma/ nag mo/ drag mo/ gzugs ngan ma rnams so/ lho nub 'tshams su rma bya'i steng du k+ṣaḥlas gzhon nu gdong drug ma dmar mo phyag bzhi ma g.yas na mdung dang lcags kyu ste/ g.yon na rin po che dang zhags pa can tshogs bdag dkar pos 'khyud pa'o// 'dab mar k+ṣi k+ṣi ra rī rī ru rli raṃ las pad ma can dang*/ yan lag med ma/ gzhon nu ma/ ri dwags bdag mo/ rin chen phreng ma/ legs mig ma/ rigs bzang ma/ bzang mo ma rnams so// nub tu glang po che'i steng du ha las byung ba'i dbang mo ni zhal cig phyag bzhi ma ser mo g.yas rdo rje dang mda'/ g.yon dril bu dang gzhu ste/ srin po nag pos 'khyud pa'o// 'dab ma la h+la h+la la li li lu l+li laṃ las/

rdo rje'i 'od ma/ rdo rje lus/ gser ldan ma/ yid 'ong ma/ ri mo 'bri ma/ ra ba ma/ le lo ma/ shin du sgrol ma rnams so// rlung gi 'tshams su ngang pa'i steng du k+ṣa las byung ba'i tshangs ma ser mo zhal cig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas pad ma dang dbyug gu can/ g.yon spyi blugs dang par bu 'dzin pa/ khyab 'jug nag pos 'khyud pa'o// 'dab ma la k+shī k+ṣ+li li lī li lū l+lī laṃ las mchod sbyin 'don ma/ pad ma'i spyan ma/ chu sgron ma/ glo ma/ ngag gi dbang phyug ma/ glu len ma/ glog ma/ dran pa mo rnams so// bya khyung mchog gi steng du haṃ las drag po dkar mo ni zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas na rtse gsum dang cang te'u/ g.yon pas kha ṭam̐ ga dang sbrul 'dzin pa gshin rje dmar pos 'khyud pa'o// 'dab mar hu hū bā bi bi bū bli baṃ las dkar mo dang gā gha mo mgyogs ma gzhan gyi ma mo dug sel ma/ mtshan ldan ma/ ser skya ma nag mo rnams so// dbang ldan mtshams su seng ge'i steng du k+ṣa las dpal chen mo/ dkar mo zhal cig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas na pad ma dang phreng ba can/ g.yon na pad ma dang rin po che cha dgu pa 'dzin pa/ gdong drug dmar pos 'khyud pa'o// 'dab mar k+ṣu k+ṣu bā brī bi bū blī bām̐ las dpal dkar mo dang*/ zla rtsis ma/ zla 'dzin gdong ma ngang pa'i mdog ma/ pho nya mo// pad dbang ma/ skar mig ma/ dri med ri bong can ma rnams so// thams cad kyang pad ma la dbus kyi yab yum rang rang gi bzhon pa la sa ga'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// 'khor gzhan rnams kun rol pa'i tshul can la/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ sku mdog dang phyag mtshan gtso mo dang mthun par bzhugs pa'o// gsung gi 'khor lo'o// de nas sku'i 'khor lo la pad ma phyogs dmar zhing 'tshams dkar ba 'dab ma bzhi dang brgyad dang bcu drug pa bcu gnyis la/ dbus su gtso bo'i gdan gzhan ni pad+ma la gnas pa ste/ shar sgo'i g.yon du bya khyung la kaṃ las khyab 'jug g.yas 'khor lo dang dbyug pa/

g.yon pad ma dang skye ba snga ma'i dung yum dpal mos 'khyud pa ste yab yum ni gnam stong dang nya'i rang bzhin gzhan ni tshes rnams te chu srin gyi khyim nang du phrag pa g.yas su ste kā khā gā gha ngā rnams la/ oṃ laṃ u ri i ā rnams kyi bsgyur ba'i sa bon las byung ba/ ming yang kaṃ rdo rje la sogs pa rnams te thams cad la mthun no// lho'i sgo'i g.yon du ngang pa la ngaṃ las gshin rje g.yas kyis dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon na lu gu rgyud dang zhags pa can yum gshin rje mas 'khyud pa/ 'dab mar nga gha ga kha ka rnams la/ a i ri u li aṃ gis bsgyur ba las byung ba bum pa'i khyim dang phrag g.yon dag pa'o// shar sgo'i g.yas su yi dwags dmar mo la tsa las bden bral g.yas na ral gri dang gri gug g.yon pas phub dang thod pa can yum srin mos 'khyud pa/ 'dab mar tsā tshā dzā dz+nyā nyā rnams la/ oṃ la sogs pas bsgyur ba nya'i khyim gru mo g.yas so// me'i 'tshams su sha ba la nyaṃ las rlung lha/ g.yas dpag bsam gyi shing dang lha shing me tog g.yon in tra ni la dang ut+pal can/ yum rab tu gtum mos 'khyud pa'i 'dab mar nya dzha dza tsha tsa rnams la a la sogs pas bsgyur ba lugs gi khyim gru mo g.yon no// lho sgo'i g.yas su ra'i gdan la ṭam̐ las me lha ni g.yas na mdung ti dang dbyug pa/ g.yon pas pad ma dang ril ba spyi blugs can yum chu bdag mos 'khyud pa 'dab mar ṭa ṭhā ḍa dha ṇa rnams la/ a la sogs pas bsgyur ba glang gi khyim 'khrig ma g.yas so// bden bral 'tshams su rma bya'i stengs su ṇaṃ las gzhon nu gdong drug ni/ g.yas na shag ti dang mdung thung can/ g.yon pa rin chen dang me long 'dzin pa yum dpal mos 'khyud pa'o// 'dab mar ṇa dha ḍa ṭha ṭa rnams la/ a la sogs pas bsgyur ba 'khrig pa'i khyim 'khrig ma g.yon pa'o// byang sgo'i g.yas su chu srin gyi gdan la paṃ las chu lha ni g.yas na zhags pa dang rin po che/

g.yon na sbrul zhags dang chu shel 'dzin pa yum phag mos 'khyud pa'o// 'dab mar pā phā bā bhā mā rnams la/ oṃ la sogs pas bsgyur ba kar ka ṭa ste dpyi g.yas so// dbang ldan 'tshams su byi ba'i steng maṃ las tshogs bdag ni g.yas na dgra sta dang rdo rje ste/ g.yon pas zhags pa dang rin po che 'dzin pa yum gzhon nu mas 'khyud pa/ 'dab mar ma bha ba pha pa rnams la/ a la sogs pas bsgyur ba/ seng ge khyim dpyi mgo g.yon pa'o/ nub sgo'i g.yas su glang po che la tām̐ las brgya byin ni g.yas rdo rje dang me'i mda'/ g.yon pa dril bu dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ yum rlung gi dbang mos 'khyud pa'o// 'dab mar tā thā dā dhā nā rnams la/ oṃ la sogs pas bsgyur ba bu mo'i khyim pus mo g.yas so/ rlung gi mtshams su ngang pa la naṃ las tshangs pa ni g.yas pas khab dang bgrang phreng ste/ g.yon pa pad ma dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa yum glog mas 'khyud pa/ 'dab mar na dha da tha ta rnams la/ a la sogs pas bsgyur ba srang gi khyim pus mo g.yon no// byang sgo'i g.yon du khyu mchog la pam̐ las drag po dbang phyug /g.yas na rtse gsum dang mda' bsnams pa/ g.yon pa sbrul gyi dkris pa'i kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ yum dkar mos 'khyud pa'o// 'dab mar sā ྐྤཱ shā ṣa ྈྐ rnams la/ oṃ la sogs pas bsgyur ba'i sdig pa'i khyim long bu g.yas so// nub sgo'i g.yon du glang gi gdan la ྈྐ las gnod sbyin ni/ g.yas rin po che dbyug to can/ g.yon ne'u le dang pad ma/ yum nor bzang mas 'khyud pa/ 'dab mar ྈྐ ṣa sha ny+pa sa rnams la/ a la sogs pas bsgyur ba gzhu'i khyim long bu g.yon pa'o// thams cad sku mdog phyogs dang mthun pa/ tshangs pa gdong bzhi pa/ gzhon nu gdong drug ma/ gzhan thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi phyag mtshan gtso bo dang mthun pa spyan gsum gsum pa gtso bo yab yum skyil dkrung dang pad ma'i 'dug stangs/ gzhan rnams rol pa'i stabs kyi bzhugs pa'o// shar sgor phag nag po bdun gyis drang pa'i shing rta la/

ya las dbyug sngon don grub lta bu/ lā las byung ba'i khro mo 'od zer can ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas na 'khor lo dang dbyug pa/ g.yon na dung dang rin chen 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'o// lho ru rta dmar po bdun gyi shing rta la ra las 'dod pa'i rgyal po rin 'byung lta bu/ bā las byung ba'i bskul byed ma dkar mo g.yas na tho ba dang mdung*/ g.yon na pad ma me long 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'o/ nub tu glang chen ser po bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta la lā las stobs chen rnam snang lta bu ste/ yā las lcags sgrog ma nag mo ni/ g.yas na ral gri dang rdo rje ste/ g.yon pa phub dang sbrul 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'o/ byang du seng ge dkar mo bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta la bā las mi g.yo ba 'od dpag med lta bu/ rā las khro gnyer ma dmar mo ni/ g.yas na mda' dang lcags kyu can/ g.yon pas gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'o// steng du bya khyung bdun gyi shing rta la/ haṃ las gtsug gtor phyag na rdo rje'i sku mdog phyag mtshan bzhin te/ ham̐ las shin du sngon mo ni/ g.yas gri gug dang rdo rje can/ g.yon na thod pa dang dril bu 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'o// 'og tu rkang brgyad kyi shing rta la/ ha las gnod mdzes kun du bzang po bzhin te/ hā las gtum mo sngon mo g.yas na dgra sta rtse gsum/ g.yon pas sbrul dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'o// nyi mar g.yas brkyang dang yum g.yon brkyang pas bzhugs pa spyan gsum khro bo'i chos kyis brgyan pa'o// de nas 'dod yon gyi steng rta babs ka ba'i rtsar shar du/ h+ya h+yā las pad ma dang stobs kyi rgyu/ lho ru hra hrā las nor rgyas dang dung skyong ngo*// nub tu h+la h+la las 'jog po dang pad ma chen po// byang du hwa hwā las mtha' yas dang rigs ldan/ steng 'og tu ham̐ hā las rgyal ba dang rnam rgyal te/ yum rab gtum bcu gnyis 'khyud pa phyogs kyi kha dog can zhal cig phyag bzhi spyan gsum pa g.yas bdud rtsi'i bum pa dang rdo rje/

g.yon pad+ma dang rin po che 'dzin pa 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa'o// de nas gsung dang sku'i snam bu la gnas pa'i 'dod ma rnams brjod de/ rigs kyi sa bon las byung ba ste/ shar sgo'i g.yas su zhe sdang 'dod ma sgrol ma lta bu gos 'dod ma reg bya rdo rje lta bu/ lus phrug par 'dod ma tsa mun ti lta bu/ bgrod 'dod ma shin du stobs ma lta bu'o// sgo'i g.yon du rab tu tsha ba 'dod ma shin tu sngon mo lta bu/ reg bya 'dod ma lcags sgrog ma lta bu/ khrus 'dod ma khyi gdong ma lta bu/ lhag ma za bar 'dod ma khwa gdong ma lta bu/ rlung khams 'du byed kyi rigs so// lho sgo'i g.yas su bstod par 'dod ma gos dkar mo lta bu/ za bar 'dod ma ro rdo rje lta bu/ sku mnye 'dod ma phag mo lta bu/ gar 'dod ma gdong drug ma lta bu/ brkam par 'dod ma rmongs byed ma lta bu'o// g.yon du 'gugs par 'dod ma khro gnyer ma lta bu/ rgyug par 'dod ma grag mig ma lta bu/ bshang gci spong 'dod ma phag gdong ma lta bu/ 'khrug par 'dod ma bya gdong ma lta bu/ me khams tshor ba'i rigs so// nub sgo'i g.yas su rengs par 'dod ma spyan ma lta bu/ dri chab 'dod ma dri rdo rje lta bu/ nyal 'dod ma dbang mo lta bu/ chu 'dod ma tshangs ma lta bu/ 'ching 'dod ma rengs byed ma lta bu'o// g.yon du 'khrig pa 'dod ma chos dbyings rdo rje ma lta bu/ phur bu 'debs par 'dod ma 'od zer can lta bu/ slu 'dod ma lce spyang gdong ma lta bu/ sbrul gyis 'ching 'dod ma bya khyung gdong ma lta bu/ sa khams gzugs kyi rigs so// byang sgo'i g.yas su rgyas par 'dod ma ma mā ki lta bu/ rgyan cha 'dod ma gzugs rdo rje ma lta bu/ gdan 'dod ma drag mo lta bu/ rgyal srid 'dod ma phun sum tshogs ma lta bu'o// 'jam por smra 'dod ma nga rgyal byed pa lta bu'o// g.yon du sgra 'dod ma sgra rdo rje lta bu/

phyag 'tshal 'dod ma tsun dha lta bu/ 'thab mo mang po 'dod ma stag gdong ma lta bu/ byis pa la khro bar 'dod ma 'ug gdong ma lta bu/ chu khams 'du shes kyi rigs so// de bzhin du 'dod log ma sum cu rtsa drug sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi snam bu la ste/ gong ma rnams dang mtshungs pa'o// phyi rol me rlung gi bar du dur khrod brgyad kyi dbus su rab gtum rnams te/ shar gyi dur khrod gsal shing gis phug par bse'i gdan las khyi gdong la/ lho ru shi ba bsregs pa ru dom gyi steng du las phag gdong ma/ nub tu rnag gi dri can du seng ge'i gdan la las lce spyang gdod ma/ byang du gsher dang bcas pa ru g.yag gi gdan la las stag gdong ma mer lhag ma za bar bhe he ru dha'i gdan la las khwa gdong ma/ lho nub 'jigs pa'i 'thab mo ru khrung khrung gi gdan la las bya rgod gdong ma/ rlung du sbrul gyis gzung ma ru mig sngon ma'i gdan la las bya khyung gi gdong ma/ byang shar byis pa shi ba ru bya ma byi'i gdan la las 'ug gdong ma/ sa 'og tu rkang brgyad kyi steng du rdo rje mig ma/ steng du shing rta la shin du sngon mo sa bon kyang ha haṃ du nges pa'o// thams cad kyang zhal cig phyag gnyis pa g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa can gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa thod phreng gis brgyan cing zlum po'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa klu bcu'i thabs dang ldan pa phyogs kyi gos can 'khor lo la rang rang gi gdan la bzhugs pa'o// gzhan yang chu dang me dang shing dang mchod rten dang*/ phyogs skyong grub pa dang*/ zhing skyong dang*/ sprin dang*/ gza' dang*/ rgyu skar dang*/ khyim dang*/ drang srong dang*/ nag po chen po dang*/ dga' byed dang*/ bum rna can dang*/ 'phrog ma la sogs pa 'byung po bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi rnams kha dog dang phyag mtshan bzhon pa sna tshogs dang bcas pa/ dur khrod phun sum tshogs pa bsgom par bya'o// de nas 'od 'phros pas rigs drug ma lus pa bsdus la dkyil 'khor du bcug ste/

bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas zhugs shing byang chub kyi sems su gyur te/ yum gyi mkha' nas lus kyi dkyil 'khor ye shes kyi rang bzhin k+ṣa la dbyangs kyis bsgyur ba las 'od 'khros pa bkod nas/ slar yang sems can thams cad la dbang bskur nas lhar gyur nas rang rang gi zhing du 'god do// de nas sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin o āḥhūm̐ ye shes ho'i 'od zhu nas yab yum gnyis ka thig le byang chub sems kyi haṃ nam mkha' lta bur gyur pa la/ lha mo bzhis tshad med pa bzhi'i glus bskul bar bya ste/ spyan ma bdag ni 'gro ba'i ma/ rgyu mthun rnal 'byor mar gnas so// bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin te// dus 'khor bdag la 'dod pa spyod// ma ma ki ni sring mo bdag /rnam smin rnal 'byor mar gnas pa// bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin te// dus 'khor bdag la 'dod pa spyod// gos dkar bu mo ru ni bdag /skyes bu rnal 'byor mar gnas pa// dkyil 'khor lnga yi rang bzhin te// dus 'khor bdag la 'dod pa spyod// sgrol ma tsha mo yi ni bdag /dri med rnal 'byor ma ru gnas// bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin te// dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod spyod// stong pa'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa// sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dang*// 'gro ba'i rtog pa'i bsam pa yis// 'gro ba'i mgon por rang gis spro// zhes bskul nas rdo rje'i glus sad nas srid pa gsum du sgyu ma lta bur gzigs pas/ haṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa de las sngar ltar sku yongs su rdzogs par blta'o// slar yang dkyil 'khor zhal du zhugs nas sngar ltar blta ste/ 'di ni rnam par dag dang rnam pa nyi shus mngon par byang chub pa mngal du grub pa dang skye ba rnam par dag pa'o// de nas hūm̐ ho las 'od sngon po 'phros nas/ skad cig gis khro bo rdo rje shugs phyag rgya lhag pas glang po'i pags pa 'dzin pa sbrul rgyan dang*// thod phreng can ma bcom ldan 'das 'dra ba shes rab dang bcas pas ye shes kyi 'khor lo bkug nas sngon bzhin du mchod la/

dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho hi zhes dgug gzhug bcings dgyes pa dang ro mnyam par bya'o// ro mnyam ni thabs dang shes rab bde ba chen por ye shes dang gnyis su med pa ste yul dang yul can mnyam pa'i don no// de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho swa hā rnams gnas lngar bya ste/ dpral bar a las zla ba la/ oṃ las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ sku rdo rje dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa g.yas nag g.yon dmar ba/ spyan gsum pa phyag g.yas na 'khor lo rdo rje pad ma'o// g.yon ral gri dril bu nor bu 'dzin pa/ shes rab dang bcas pa nam mkha' khengs pas sems can thams cad la chos bstan nas/ lha mo rnams kyis glu dang bcas pas dbang bskur zhing*/ dpal ldan rdo rje sku 'chang ba/ rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// de dag byin gyis brlabs nas ni// rdo rje'i dbang ni mdzad du gsol// phyogs bcur gnas pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// de dag byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// rdo rje'i skur ni mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod cing dbang bskur nas dpral bar bzhugs so// mgrin par ra las nyi ma/ aḥlas pad ma yongs su gyur pa las/ gsung rdo rje dmar po zhal g.yas dkar g.yon nag po/ g.yas pad ma rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon nor bu dril bu ral gri 'dzin pa yum dang bcas pas sngar ltar ngag byin gyi brlabs te// dpal ldan rdo rje gsung 'chang ba// zhes sngar ltar brjod do// snying gar thig le sngon po las sgra can la hūm̐ la rdo rje rtse lnga pa las gyur pa'i thugs rdo rje sngon po g.yas dmar g.yon dkar ba/ g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo pad ma/ g.yon dril bu nor bu ral gri 'dzin pa/ yum dang bcas pa spyan gsum pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pas thugs byin gyis brlab bo// dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba// zhes tshigs bcad sngar ltar brjod do// oṃ sarba ta thā gā ta ka ya wa ka tsit+ta badz+ra sa bha wa ad ma ko ྅ haṃ zhes nga rgyal bya'o// de ltar dbang bskur zhing sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas rigs kyis rgyas gdab par bya ste/

bcom ldan 'das yab yum ni ngo bo nyid kyis rdo rje sems dpa' dang mi bskyod pa dbyer med pa nyid do// rnam snang la mi bskyod pa/ 'od dpag med la rnam snang ngo*// rin chen 'byung ldan la 'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa la rin 'byung ste/ sprul pa'i sku chos gos dang bcas pa'o// gzhan shar lho nub byang gi lha rnams ni ral gri rin chen 'khor lo pad+mas rgyas gdab bo// rdo rje dang gri gug ni steng 'og tu'o// de ltar dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog rdzogs nas mi skyo ba'i bar bsgom par bya'o// dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor ro// bzlas pa byed par 'dod pa spro bsdu la sogs pa'i rim pas/ oṃ hrām̐ hrī hṝ hūm̐ hl̥̄ hrāḥzhes 'don pa'i rim pa'am/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣa ma la ba ra ya phaṭa swā hā zhes rtsa ba dang rkang pa bcu drug pa mkha' 'gro ma dra ba dang lhan cig pa'am/ phreng sngags la sogs pa bzlas te sngags kyi rnal 'byor las rgyal mchog go /de nas sngar ltar mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs pa las byung ba'i shes rab kyi chags pas haṃ las byang chub kyi sems zhu zhing*/ bde ba chen po thig le gnyis mi 'gyur ba bsgom pa ni thig le'i rnal 'byor ro// de nyid la bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo dang lhan cig par dbugs dbyung ba dang 'jug pa 'od zer lnga pa'i sngags dang lhan cig pa ni phra mo'i rnal 'byor dang rdo rje'i bzlas pa'o// de nas phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa byas te/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ ces pa la sogs pas bstod par byas nas/ skyo na rnam par dag pa dran par bya ste// 'di bsdus te bstod pa'i tshul du brjod pa// khyab bdag dpa' bo dus 'khor lo// sems nyid rnam par dag pa ni// mngal du ye shes rnam shes kyi// rang bzhin bcom ldan rdo rje sems// rtags bcu snying ga'i 'khor lo dang*// rlung bcu sa bcu lha mo bcu// khu khrag bshang lci sha dang rkang*// bum pa stobs bcu rnam dag pa// a haṃ la sogs steng 'og gi// lha rnams rnam dag phyag 'tshal lo// lus ngag yid dang ye shes kyi// sgrib zad gtsug gtor 'khor lo'i rtsa// gaṇ+ḍī la sogs rnam pa bzhi// dag pa'i sku bzhir phyag 'tshal lo// i sogs 'du byed rlung khams dang*// bya grub don grub sgrol ma ste// ṛ sogs tshor ba me'i khams/

mnyam nyid rin 'byung gos dkar mo// u sogs 'du shes chu yi khams// sor rtog 'od dpag ma ma ki// l̥ sogs gzugs dang sa yi khams// chos dbyings rnam snang sangs rgyas spyan// nyon mongs lnga po ye shes skur// phan tshun sbyor bas bcu drug ste/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo rnam dag pa/ rgyal ba yab yum phyag 'tshal lo// yul drug yul can rnam shes drug /dbang po drug dang mgrin pa yi// 'khor lor thig le rnam dag pa// sems dpa' sems ma khro bo bzhi// dbang po lnga yi rtsa rnams dang*// dad pa'i stobs sogs gtsug gtor sogs// dbang po lnga po dbyug sngon sogs// rnam dag thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// lte ba'i 'khor lor dbyug gu dang*// las rlung gsung gi lha mo rnams// rtsa muṇ+ḍa sogs thun brgyad dang*// la s+ye sogs pa gsang ba yi// rtsa ste dbyangs rnams rnam dag pa// gsung gi lha rnams phyag 'tshal lo// gsal byed lo zla'i zhag rnams dang*// tshigs chen bcu gnyis 'khor lo'i rtsa// sgrib pa zad cing rnam dag pa// sku yi pad+ma bcu gnyis so// sor tshigs khams dang rtsa dag pa// klu dang gtum mo rnam rang bzhin// 'dod dang mi 'dod rtog pa rnams// rnam dag stegs bu'i lha mo rnams// ba spu'i rtsa rnams 'byung po ste// sku'i dkyil 'khor phyag 'tshal lo// nyon mongs bdud dang drag po bcom// mngal du dag pa'i sku bzhi rdzogs// sad pa rmi lam gnyid 'thug dang*// chags pa'i gnas skabs rnam dag pa// phyi nang gzhan gsum ye shes su// dag pa de la phyag 'tshal 'dud// ces brjod cing don bsgom mo// spros pa la dga' na dbang chog tu bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dag pa yang brjod do// thun bsdu bar 'dod na bsrung 'khor du bshad pa ltar lus rdo rjer bltas la spyi gtsug tu rdo rje bzhi bsdu'o// snying gar du ba la sogs pa rnams so// spyi bor sangs rgyas lha mo rnams so/

mgrin par sems dpa' sems ma rnams dang khro bo bzhi'o// lte bar gsung gi lha rnams so// gsang bar sku'i khro bo yab yum rnams so// tshigs chen bcu gnyis kyi 'khor lo la sku'i lha rnams so// sor tshigs la klu dang gtum mo rnams so// ba spu la dur khrod kyi 'byung po rnams gshegs su gsol te// thun mtshams kyi spyod pa thams cad lha'i nga rgyal gyi bya'o// gsum pa las so so'i lha dang sngags kyi nges pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pas mchog bsgrub pa dang*/ gtor ma'i cho ga rnams kho bos logs su byas so// dpal ldan shākya seng ge yis/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs mchod rten du// dpal ldan rgyu skar dkyil 'khor can// dpal ldan dam pa dang po bstan// phyi nang gzhan gsum ye shes rim// dri mar bcas pa'i sems sbyang phyir// 'jal ba'i dbyangs kyis gang bsdus pa// pad ma dkar 'dzin bka' drin gyis// rtogs pas rol pa'i rdo rje yis// gzhan don blo yis bsdus pa yin// 'gal dang nor 'khrul gyur pa na// bla ma mkha' 'gros bzod par mdzod// dge bas sems can thams cad kyis// ye shes sku nyid thob par shog dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i mngon bar rtogs pa rnam dag snang ba zhes bya ba rgyud 'grel gyi dgongs pa ltar/ mkhas la grub pa thob pa u rgyan pa rin chen dpal gyi dgongs pa dang mthun par/ rang byung rdo rje yis mtshur phu'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o// rdzogs so/// /dge'o// legs so//
